subject: Chronos: Data sovereignty questions & logs retention — scheduling sync
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@chronos.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <p.rao@chronos.ai>, security@chronos.ai
Date: 2026-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: intake sync for CAIQ/SIG + data residency concerns

Hi Diego,

Thanks for taking this on. We (Chronos security) are kicking off a questionnaire review and have a few blocking items we'd like to clarify before the CAIQ/SIG submission:

- Data residency: do you offer regionally isolated hosting for EU-only data (no egress to US control plane)?
- Log retention & exports: we need examples of the audit/access logs and a sanitized sample for our compliance team to validate retention and redaction practices.
- Cross-border transfers: what contractual/technical controls cover cross-border transfers, and do you support SCCs or equivalent?
- SOC 2 evidence: can you provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report or an attestation and the date range covered?

We'd like a short intake call (30 min) to align on what evidence you'll provide and to confirm timelines. Our availability next week (CEST):
- Tue 2026-04-21: 10:00–13:00 CEST
- Wed 2026-04-22: 14:00–17:00 CEST

Attaching our initial CAIQ spreadsheet (chronos_caig_questions_v1.xlsx). Can you confirm an internal owner(s) who will join? Ideally someone from infra and someone who can speak to logs/retention.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Carter
Security Program Manager | Chronos.ai

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@chronos.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-04-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: intake sync for CAIQ/SIG + data residency concerns

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the clear list. Diego from Redwood here — I'll own the intake and follow-up. Quick answers up front and then scheduling:

- Regionally isolated hosting: we offer an EU-dedicated private deployment (VPC) that can be configured so customer data and inference workloads stay in-region. Control-plane metadata routing can be restricted by contract; we'll surface the deployment topology docs on the call.
- Log samples: we can provide a sanitized log bundle showing authentication events, API usage, and RBAC changes. Note: for security we sanitize PII and customer identifiers; sample will be hashed+redacted.
- Cross-border transfers: we support SCCs and can provide a template; for Hosted API customers we have contractual clauses and optional geo-routing policies.
- SOC 2: latest Type II audit completed 2025-10-31; we can provide the report under NDA or via a secure share.

Proposed slots in your timezone converted to PST (my calendar):
- Tue 2026-04-21: 01:00–04:00 PDT (10:00–13:00 CEST)
- Wed 2026-04-22: 05:00–08:00 PDT (14:00–17:00 CEST)

Please pick one. I'll have Marissa (security operations) join for logs and Hannah (compliance) join for contractual controls/SOC2.

Action I will take before the call:
- Upload a sanitized log sample to a secure Box link (redwood-log-sample-sanitized.tar.gz)
- Prepare a short deployment diagram showing EU private option and control-plane flow
- Pull SOC2 attestation and redaction rules for the sample

If you need the sample earlier, let me know and we can share under a quick NDA.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Manager, Security/Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@chronos.ai>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodai.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodai.com>, security@chronos.ai
Date: 2026-04-16T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: intake sync for CAIQ/SIG + data residency concerns

Thanks — adding a couple clarifications from ops that will help Chronos validate quickly: 

- We'll provide two artifacts: (1) sanitized log bundle (auth + admin + audit) and (2) a retention policy excerpt that shows retention defaults and configurable TTLs per customer. Both will be hashed/redacted as Diego noted.
- For access to the samples we'll provision a short-lived S3 pre-signed URL or a Box shared folder (your preference). Recommend Box if you need link-based access controls + view-only.
- HSM/KMS: our EU private deployment supports customer-managed keys via KMS; we can show a diagram of key flows. If you require HSM-backed attestations (FIPS/HSM), flag that requirement before the call.

Quick ask for the call prep from Chronos:
- Which team will validate logs (security or platform)?
- Any special redaction rules (e.g., must remove all IPs vs. can be hashed)?
- Do you require copies of our internal runbooks for incident response? We can provide a summary, but full runbooks are restricted.


On Thu, Apr 15, 2026 at 09:12 AM Alex Carter <alex.carter@chronos.ai> wrote:
> Hi Diego,
>
> Thanks for taking this on. We (Chronos security) are kicking off a questionnaire review...

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@chronos.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodai.com>, Priya Rao <p.rao@chronos.ai>, security@chronos.ai
Date: 2026-04-17T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: intake sync for CAIQ/SIG + data residency concerns

Diego / Marissa —

Wed 2026-04-22 15:00 CEST works for us (that's 06:00 PDT for you). Priya (data protection) and two engineers from our platform team will join; we'll also have our procurement rep sit in for a short intro to timelines.

We prefer Box for artifacts. For redaction, Chronos requires IP addresses to be removed (hashed is acceptable) and any PII to be redacted. Our log validation will be done by security with platform engineering as technical reviewers.

Two small asks before the call:
1) Can you post the log sample to the Box link and grant view-only to alex.carter@chronos.ai and p.rao@chronos.ai?
2) Please bring the SOC2 attestation (even if redacted) and a short deployment diagram for the EU private option.

I'll send a calendar invite for Wed Apr 22 15:00 CEST and include a short meeting agenda. Thanks for being responsive — looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Alex Carter
Security Program Manager | Chronos.ai

Meeting notes (added by Diego after call):
- Call date: 2026-04-22T15:00:00+02:00
- Attendees: Alex Carter (Chronos), Priya Rao (Chronos), Chronos platform eng x2, Diego Fernandez (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Hannah Schmitt (Redwood)
- Summary: Walked through EU private deployment topology, showed control-plane isolation options, reviewed sanitized log sample, and confirmed redaction approach for IPs. Discussed SCCs and timeline for legal review.
- Action items:
  * Diego: upload final sanitized log bundle to Box and grant access (due 2026-04-23)
  * Marissa: provide retention policy excerpt and KMS keyflow diagram (due 2026-04-24)
  * Hannah: share SOC2 attestation under NDA via secure link (due 2026-04-24)
  * Chronos (Priya): confirm whether they need an HSM attestation and send any procurement checklist items (due 2026-04-27)
